cohort: The study included 120 immediate postpartum women (55 cases with postpartum anemia; 65 controls without) at the Central Hospital of the Peruvian Air Force.
finding: Fewer prenatal visits showed a marginal association with immediate postpartum anemia, while antenatal anemia was identified as the dominant risk factor.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between mode of delivery and postpartum anemia.
